Models equipped with 4-speed automatic transmission utilize an electronically controlled variable transfer clutch to distribute power to where traction

VDC electronic stability control utilizes sensors which constantly monitor wheel speed, steering angle, brake pressure, vehicle yaw rate and lateral

and/or reduces engine torque to help correct vehicle path.
